title: Emrys and the Machine
author: Odile Pemberton
blurb: Silas Marchetti, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
